{{Current events|year=2023|month=03|day=6|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]], [[Terrorism in Pakistan]]
**[[Bolan suicide bombing]]
***At least nine [[Law enforcement in Pakistan|police officer]]s are killed and 16 other people are injured in [[Sibi District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]], when a [[Baloch nationalism|separatist]] [[suicide bomber]] riding on a motorcycle [[vehicle-ramming attack|rams]] a [[Balochistan Police|police]] vehicle. [https://www.dw.com/en/pakistan-suicide-bomb-kills-police-officers-in-balochistan/a-64894133 (DW)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Five [[Palestinians]] are injured by [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]] attacking a family on a street in [[Huwara]], in the [[West Bank]]. Twenty-five Palestinians are injured by [[tear gas]] fired by [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] during the attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/7/israeli-attack-wounds-palestinians-as-settlers-and-soldiers-dance (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Serasan landslide]]
**Eleven people are killed and an estimated 50 others are missing when a [[landslide]] buries houses in [[Natuna Regency]], [[Riau Islands]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/landslide-kills-least-10-indonesias-remote-natuna-region-2023-03-06/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–China relations]]
**[[2019 Canadian Parliament infiltration plot]]
***[[Canadian prime minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] appoints an independent [[special rapporteur]] to investigate alleged [[foreign electoral intervention]] by the [[Chinese government]] in the [[2019 Canadian federal election|2019]] and [[2021 Canadian federal election]]s. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/03/07/23/canada-launches-probe-into-alleged-chinese-election-interference (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
*[[Japan–South Korea relations]]
**[[South Korea]] agrees to pay [[financial compensation|compensation]] to citizens who were [[forced labour|forced to work]] in [[Japan]]ese factories during [[World War II]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-64858944 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Belarus]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] five opposition politicians after a [[trial in absentia]]. [[Pavel Latushko|Pavel Latushka]] is sentenced to 18 years, [[Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya]] to 15 years, and Maryya Maroz, [[Olga Kovalkova|Volha Kavalkova]] and Siarhei Dylevski to 12 years each. [https://apnews.com/article/belarus-opposition-sentenced-trial-tsikhanouskaya-38240b15e7c4bd5d87f382bd92100f4e (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 transport strike in the Philippines]]
**Operators of traditional public [[jeepney]]s and [[minivan]]s that are opposed to the implementation of the [[Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program]] organize a weeklong nationwide [[strike action|strike]] in the [[Philippines]]. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/transport-groups-strike-against-jeepney-phaseout-starting-march-6-2023/ (Rappler)]
*[[2023 Turkish presidential election]]
**The [[Republican People's Party]], [[Turkey]]'s main opposition party, nominates [[List of the main opposition leaders of Turkey|its leader]] [[Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu]] as its candidate in the upcoming election. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/03/06/world/middleeast/erdogan-turkey-election-kilicdaroglu.html (''The New York Times'')]
